name: Hurricane Screw Shot
main_effect:
When an effect trashes this card from your Digimon's digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
While you have [Three Musketeers] trait Digimon, you can ignore this card's color requirements.
[Main] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 3, 1 of their level 4, and 1 of their level 5 Digimon. Then, place this card as the bottom digivolution card of 1 of your Digimon with the [Three Musketeers] trait.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Delete 1 of your opponent's level 3 Digimon, level 4 Digimon, and level 5 Digimon.
